permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects to the team's glasses service on the local network to get the rescue view.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Sends the rescuer's position so the view can show distance and direction to survivors.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Records a short spoken question only while the rescuer asks one, so the coordinator team can answer it.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Records a short spoken question on the phone when the glasses microphone is unavailable.
